ruling.recommended_action: Prepare case file for human safety review; do not rule on fault. Preserve chat log and trip telemetry, conduct welfare check on rider, and consider interim suspension of the driver's account pending review.
ruling.reasoning: Dispute type is safety and the record contains a threat/feeling-unsafe allegation, so the safety screen governs and no ruling on the merits is permitted (SAFE-1 / §5.2, SAFE-3). The rider's complaint states the driver "threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out" and that she "felt unsafe for the whole ride"; this is corroborated in the chat record: the rider asked to stop and get out at 22:30 [F3], and the driver replied at 22:31 "Sit down or I lock the doors" [F4], a threat and an apparent refusal to let the rider alight, which the driver's later written statement [F6] does not deny (it admits telling her to sit down and driving on). Every chat message is timestamped and the log is complete [F5], and the GPS shows no route deviation of concern [F1][F2] — the fare/route aspects are not the issue here. There is no allegation of collision or injury, so this is a threat/intimidation and rider-safety escalation (SAFE-1) rather than an accident case (SAFE-2). Both profiles show no prior disputes or flags [F7][F8], so no account flagging clause (RD-6, NS-2, NS-9) is triggered. Interim measures under SAFE-4 may be applied after escalation. I do not determine fault, as SAFE-3 bars that.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute (threat/intimidation and rider feeling unsafe during the ride). Under SAFE-1/SAFE-3 the system cannot rule or assign fault; case file referred to a human reviewer, with interim suspension option under SAFE-4.

element_findings.reason: Text describes a threat ('I lock the doors') and the rider's stated fear for her safety; SAFE-1 requires escalation regardless of dispute type.

safety_basis: Driver chat: 'Sit down or I lock the doors' — threat, refusal to let rider alight (F4)
Rider request to stop and get out at 22:30 (F3)
Rider complaint: driver threatened to lock her in; felt unsafe for the whole ride
Driver statement admits instructing rider to sit down and driving on (F6)
